purpose: Read-only pinned residual backend, auxiliary-PC reuse/action implementation and public matrix identity/state APIs for Rana trajectory verification
inspected_contracts: RanaLD requires one-test-argument state Function residual and uses a copied LD tableau
Residual backend propagates constant_jacobian to the Firedrake problem
AuxiliaryOperatorPC initializes P and LU once; its update reassembles P if PETSc requests setup
Each AssembledPC.apply calls its fixed internal PC once; no inner KSP for the selected LU configuration
PETSc Object.getId/stateGet and PC.getFactorMatrix are available in the installed binding stub
PETSc PCSetUp returns before its event when setup/matrix state is unchanged
MatSolve, MatLUFactorSym and MatLUFactorNum are registered PETSc events; count actual auxiliary LU solves and factorization work separately from the probe
